summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity Real Estate Investment ETF (FPRO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund is an actively-managed, non-transparent ETF that invests in global real estate companies. The fund utilizes the Fidelity non-transparent model. FPRO was launched on Feb 2, 2021 and is issued by Fidelity.

holdings.infoBox: FPRO is an equity ETF with a total of 45 individual holdings. The top holdings are Prologis stock at 9.92%, Equinix at 9.21%, American Tower at 8.81%, Welltower at 7.61%, and Simon Property Group at 5.27%.
